tagline: A leading supplier of critical advanced materials and process solutions for the semiconductor and other high-technology industries
hero_kpi_rationale: The HPC / cloud / AI segment is the primary driver of demand for advanced semiconductors, in which Entegris plays a critical role through its purity and materials solutions for the most advanced nodes. This structural trend amplifies its content per wafer and long-term growth.

kpis.name: AI / cloud segment revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to high-performance computing, cloud and artificial intelligence applications, key drivers of demand for advanced semiconductors.
kpis.description: HPC, cloud and AI applications represent an increasing share of semiconductor demand, driving higher need for Entegris' materials and purity solutions.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by AI adoption and advanced nodes

kpis.name: Gross margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that remains after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: High gross margin reflects the value-added nature of scientific solutions and limited competition in certain specialized products.
kpis.signal: High margin for a semiconductor materials supplier, indicating technological differentiation

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Operating profit divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin is improving due to better absorption of fixed costs and optimization of the value chain.

kpis.name: R&D investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: R&D investment supports innovation in new materials (e.g. molybdenum) and contamination challenges at sub-5nm nodes.
kpis.signal: Targeted R&D on advanced materials and purity, despite slight decline

kpis.name: Capital expenditures (fabs)
kpis.explanation: Annual spending on new factories, equipment and production tools.
kpis.description: Capex is increasing to strengthen production capacity, particularly near Asian semiconductor manufacturing hubs.
kpis.signal: Capex rising to meet customer demand for capacity

kpis.name: Total headcount (employees)
kpis.description: Headcount is growing to strengthen R&D, manufacturing and customer support teams in key regions.
kpis.signal: Headcount growth to support technological expansion

kpis.name: Share of deals including AI features
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customer projects related to cloud that integrate AI components, reflecting increasing adoption.
kpis.description: The rise of AI applications is pushing foundries to adopt new architectures, increasing demand for Entegris' solutions.
kpis.signal: Clear acceleration of AI integration in semiconductor projects

kpis.name: Entegris content per wafer
kpis.explanation: Average value of Entegris products used in the manufacturing of an advanced wafer.
kpis.description: Advanced nodes (3nm, 2nm) require more materials and purity control, increasing the value of the Entegris product basket.
kpis.signal: Increasing technical content per wafer due to rising process complexity

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Fluctuations in semiconductor demand
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cyclical fluctuations in demand for semiconductors, which can have a significant impact on its sales and operating results.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks and trade tensions
risks.score_rationale: The company faces major geopolitical risks, including the Ukraine-Russia and Israel-Hamas conflicts, as well as U.S.-China trade tensions that could affect operations and sales.

risks.title: Supplier dependency and supply chain risks
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on sole or limited suppliers for certain critical raw materials (including those from China), creating risks of major disruption.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and IT risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks, including cyberattacks, IT system failures and network outages that could affect critical operations.

risks.title: Competition and customer base consolidation
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive market with a concentrated customer base (risk of consolidation among major foundries), impacting sales and margins.

risks.title: Regulatory and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to regulatory changes in environment, health, safety, accounting standards and governance that could impact operations and costs.

risks.title: Environmental risks and climate change
risks.score_rationale: The company faces risks from climate change, strict ESG regulations and raw material risks linked to environmental pressures.

ai_positioning.summary: Entegris is positioned as a critical infrastructure supplier for AI and cloud computing. The company benefits directly from the structural increase in demand for advanced semiconductors and high-purity materials for AI, with rising content per wafer at the most advanced nodes (2nm, 3nm). AI is highlighted in the 10-K as a key long-term demand driver.
evidence: Multiple mentions in Item 1 Business: 'artificial intelligence (AI), high-performance and cloud computing' listed as key applications driving semiconductor demand
MD&A discussion of molybdenum integration at advanced nodes supporting AI applications
Content per wafer increasing with node complexity (3nm, 2nm) driven by AI requirements
Forward guidance reflects AI and cloud computing as primary demand drivers
